name: Hex nuts
description: Based on ISO 4032. Select sketch points or circles: each gets a nut, and its pocket if you want one. With nothing selected, one nut sits on the origin.

size.title: Size
size.description: Common ISO 4032 sizes with the coarse thread. For any other size, such as a fine pitch, fill in Custom size. A DIN 934 nut is wider at M10, M12 and M14: set Custom width for it.

create.title: Create
create.description: Nut only builds the nut, on the origin when nothing is selected. Nut and pocket also cuts a hexagonal pocket in the part under each selected point, with a clearance hole for the bolt, and sets the nut in it flush. Pocket only cuts without a nut.

pocket_adjust.title: Pocket adjustment
pocket_adjust.description: Used when Create cuts a pocket. Gap between each flat of the nut and the pocket. Printed pockets come out small: raise this until the nut drops in.

custom_size.title: Custom size
custom_size.description: Optional. A metric size that replaces Size, such as M8x1 or M3.5. ISO 4032 lists M1.6 to M64; a size outside that table also needs Custom width and Custom thickness.

custom_thickness.title: Custom thickness
custom_thickness.description: Optional. Nut height. Leave empty for the ISO 4032 height.

custom_width.title: Custom width
custom_width.description: Optional. Width across the flats. Leave empty for the ISO 4032 width.

sketch.title: Sketch
sketch.description: Optional. Leave empty to use the point or circle you selected before opening this. To place by name instead, type the sketch name here and fill in Sketch point.

sketch_point.title: Sketch point
sketch_point.description: Optional. The id of a point or circle in that sketch, such as c1 or c1.center. Leave empty to use the selection.

thread_modeled.title: Modeled thread
thread_modeled.description: Cut the internal thread. Off leaves a cosmetic thread, which rebuilds faster.
